The '''Videll system''' was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Videllan]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Razor" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Videll [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square M-13.<ref name="EAOC" />
